story:
It was a sunny day at Oakdale Elementary School. Soomin was so excited to show off his brand-new lunchbox, with its bright red color and fun designs on the side. But when he got to the cafeteria, OH NO! His lunchbox was GONE!

Soomin's eyes widened in worry. He asked his friend Emma, who was sitting at a nearby table, "Have you seen my lunchbox?" Emma looked surprised and said, "No, I haven't seen it! Let me ask my friends." She turned to the kids around her and shouted, "Hey, guys! Soomin's lost his lunchbox. Has anyone seen it?"

The classroom pet, a fluffy hamster named Mr. Whiskers, twitched his whiskers and looked up from his cage with interest. Mrs. Johnson, their kind teacher, smiled and said, "Don't worry, Soomin. We'll find your lunchbox together!"

Emma's friend Olivia suggested they make a list of everywhere Soomin had been since he got to school that morning. Soomin thought for a moment and then remembered: "I sat on the swings with Emma during recess, and then I went to the library with Mrs. Johnson to read a book."

The friends decided to search the playground and the library together. When they got to the swings, they called out, "Has anyone seen Soomin's lunchbox?" The swings creaked in the breeze as they searched high and low.

After a few minutes of searching, Olivia exclaimed, "I think I see something shiny under the slide!" They all ran over and found Soomin's lunchbox tucked away behind the slide! It was covered in dirt and leaves, but it was safe!

Soomin beamed with happiness. "Thank you, friends! You helped me find my lunchbox!" Emma smiled and said, "We're a team! We can solve any mystery together!"

As they walked back to their classroom, Mrs. Johnson gave Soomin a high-five and said, "You know what? Helping others is like having a superpower. It makes everyone feel happy and safe."

Soomin grinned from ear to ear. He knew that with friends by his side, he could face any challenge that came his way.
